messages:
lena: Quick heads-up — staging perf diffs after the last rollout. On H100, when seq_len > 128 and KV cache is cold, the router is increasingly picking CUTLASS lanes and p99 latency jumps (~20% in our smoke runs). Repro is straightforward in staging.
omar: Interesting. Did sampling show any correlation with batch size? When seq spikes we usually see batch sizes collapse.
lena: Yes — batch size drops to 1 a lot. Example probe line: `router.decision model=redwood-13b seq=256 batch=1 hw=h100 chosen=cutlass_v2 est_lat=9.2ms probe_score=0.82 kv_warm=false`.
raj: Can you repro with the CLI probe? `./tools/probe --model redwood-13b --seq 256 --hw h100 --kv_state=cold` If KV cold is the culprit our hysteresis/TTL for switching might be too short.
sophia: @lena can you share a quick perf flame for both kernel paths? I'm particularly curious about memcpy/setup overhead vs token loop.
lena: Will upload soon, but quick notes: CUTLASS shows ~2.6ms extra memcpy/setup, TRITON path shows steadier token loop with lower variance. Also saw the autotuner stick to CUTLASS after a 512 spike — it doesn't back off quickly enough and persists that choice ~30s, which hurts mixed workloads.
kernel-bot: autotuner:probe_event id=4521 route=cutlass_v2 latency_regret=1.15 fallback_count=0
omar: Proposal: increase triton_priority for seq>128 to 0.7, extend probe sample window to 120s, and add a fallback TTL so a single cold-KV spike doesn't stick for long.
raj: +1. Also, record KV cache hit flag in probe telemetry — heuristics currently ignore KV state so decisions are blind to cold/warm transitions.
sophia: I can run an A/B canary in staging. I'll flip the config for a 10% traffic slice and run loadgen with mixed seq distribution (1..512) and KV cold startups.
lena: Assigning action items: raj -> add kv_hit flag and TTL on fallback; omar -> tweak triton_weight and sampling window; sophia -> run canary and collect traces. I will prepare rollback steps and gather traces. :rocket: 
omar: Noted. If p99 regression >10% we rollback route policy immediately to previous commit.
sophia: I'll post the canary summary and flame graphs here by EOD.
kernel-bot: config-deploy staging: set triton_priority=0.7 for seq>128 at 2019990120
lena: Got the deploy event, starting runs now. If anyone needs raw traces ping me for the S3 link.
